pathway.title: Run deliverable comparison
pathway.question: What changed between the prior and current deliverables?

blocks.title: Changes across the seven requested dimensions

cells.text: 156 delivered core facts from CP-1/CP-1A/CP-2; CP-MODEL blocked. No separately published Model numeric register.

Same156 core facts plus2,005 CP-MODEL representation facts, including81 annual numeric cells:74 known and7 missing. FY2024 operating EBIT plus D&A3,843, issuer ordinary EBITDA3,813 and issuer As Defined4,173 USDm remain separate.

Publication addition, not financial growth or a revision of historical figures. Missing prior publication is not a zero baseline; representation counts are not unique new issuer facts. The three earnings bases cannot be subtracted as a time-series change or treated as one definition.
P/C View core modules equal; C calculation.json values/FY2024 and model-view.json CP-MODEL history/ratios.
Main historical base2024-09-30; underlying annual FY2022–FY2024 history and separately dated subsequent events in unchanged core handoffs.

Same main financial date. Model annual windows retain exact October-to-September dates. Additional raw quarter tables retain2024-10-01–2024-12-28 versus2023-10-01–2023-12-30, with reported89/91-day durations; conditional annual planning windows remain separately labelled.
More period visibility without advancing the main assessment date. Added quarter evidence is later than the annual base and is not an equal-duration or newly normalized/LTM series.
P/C view.json run.as_of; C calculation.json start_date/end_date; C quarter.md context map lines41–43 and retained source tables.
The five-section CP-2 assessment does not contain a newly adopted conditional forecast or a new Model publication. Existing core assumptions/unknowns stay explicit.

The same CP-2 assessment, plus literal conditional CP-2G tables and unchanged forecast_exact.json. Reference/downside/upside drivers, exclusions, access/minimum-cash gaps and analyst watches remain stipulated/qualified.

Publishing the retained illustration is not a new source-supported central forecast or evidence that CP-2 adopted these extra scenarios in this run. No new paid or independent analytical execution occurred merely to render them.
P/C CP-2.md byte equality; C forecast.md T2H.3/T2H.7/T2H.9 and Gaps; forecast_exact.json SHA04907444….
Medium fundamental confidence and CP-2 Ready with limitations. The annual operating case is counterbalanced by debt-supported shareholder allocation, cash-access and contractual-control uncertainty.
Identical CP-2 text and identical five narrative report blocks. The Model makes selected historical definitions/calculations visible; CP-MODEL is candidate, not native accepted.
No analytical upgrade, adverse issuer event or new security recommendation is established by this delivery revision. New output availability closes the named publication gap only.
P/C report-view.json blocks equal; P/C CP-2.md assessment line42, Critical restrictions lines155–156 and readiness line174; View module statuses.
Same checked annual CP-1, business/governance CP-1A and fundamental CP-2 handoffs copied into the delivery.

Those exact inputs remain; Model also copies the checked quarter handoff SHA8be815a5…, conditional forecast handoff SHA696d6c06… and exact forecast JSON SHA04907444…. Model sources have explicit handoff-line/hash citations.

Coverage and presentation expanded through additional retained analytical artifacts. An analytical handoff is not a new primary issuer filing, and duplicate source aliases do not add independent confirmation. Scope and dates remain those of each original handoff.
P/C copied-handoff hashes; C calculation.json inputs; C quarter.md,forecast.md,forecast_exact.json and model-view.json sources.
No published Model/charts; the two inherited Critical contract/current-liquidity restrictions and other CP-1/CP-1A/CP-2 gaps remain.

The named Model/chart/JSON publication now exists. Core creditor restrictions remain unchanged. Seven annual numeric entries remain missing; quarter/source-unit and conditional forecast limitations persist. Native/provider/full-pathway acceptance remains unproven.

A delivered Model does not establish accessible liquidity, covenant/agency measures, complete claims, sustainable FCF or full current underwriting. Old workbook-export wording inside retained historical handoffs is superseded by the user's ingestion-only ruling, not a new work requirement.
P/C delivery.json cp_model_published; P/C CP-2 Gaps; C calculation.json missing amounts; quarter.md G1–G7; forecast.md T2H.9/Gaps; both current publication scope banners.
Five populated narrative sections; no Model HTML, chart publication or calculation JSON in that bundle.

Those same five sections plus model.html,calculation.json,Model views and copied supporting handoffs/exact forecast. Three annual charts contain18 observations;51 raw handoff tables and two numeric tables are retained in CP-MODEL.

A material, bounded delivery gain: report-to-Model/JSON navigation and source-backed presentation are available. It does not qualify all pathways, formats, sources or native analytical runs. No Excel output is added.
P/C delivery.json file lists/scope; C model-report-view.json two blocks and three figures; C model-view.json53 tables; report.html Model/JSON destinations.
